title: Çakışan accept merge’i node’u done yapmasın ve checkout’u yarım merge’de bırakmasın
name: accept-merge-state
description: packages/core/src/review.ts içindeki acceptWork kabul kaydını mergeNode çağrısından önce yazıyor; mergeNode çakışmada git merge durumunu bırakıyor. Yerel accept yolunda merge başarısızlığında kabul kaydı oluşmamasını, çalışma ağacının güvenli biçimde önceki durumuna dönmesini veya açık çözüm durumunun dürüstçe raporlanmasını sağla. Başarılı merge, PR kabul yolu ve yeniden deneme semantiğini koru; çakışan branch’lerle integration testi ekle. Hedef development; main release akışına dokunma.

brief.approach:
In packages/core/src/review.ts `acceptWork`, keep the pull-request path's existing order and change only local `dispatch.accept === 'merge'`: validate the branch and collect acceptance metadata, merge onto the requested base, then write `acceptNode` only after a successful merge. Preserve the branch/worktree until both steps succeed. In packages/core/src/merge.ts `mergeNode`, capture the clean base checkout's HEAD before `git merge --no-ff`; on a conflict, run `git merge --abort` and verify the checkout has returned to that HEAD with no MERGE_HEAD or tracked changes. If abort fails, return an explicit recovery error that names the unresolved merge state rather than claiming it was restored. Handle a failed post-merge acceptance write by safely reverting only the merge just created when the checkout still matches its expected commit; otherwise report the partial state clearly for manual recovery. Preserve successful local merge cleanup and retry semantics, and do not alter main release behavior. In test/integration/review.test.ts create genuinely conflicting commits on the base and node branch, then assert refusal leaves accepted null, status not done, original base HEAD and clean checkout, and permits a later retry after resolving the branch conflict. Retain existing success and PR-path coverage. Complexity 7/10: this crosses Git state and board-record ordering, and the failure paths need real-repository tests.

The same ordering also closes accept-dirty-done-9s6z. `mergeNode`'s other refusals (uncommitted changes in the main checkout, merge.ts:31, and "not on <base>", merge.ts:36) now fire before any `accepted` record exists. Add one more test in test/integration/review.test.ts: with a modified tracked file in the main checkout, `acceptWork` rejects with the uncommitted-changes refusal, the node's record has no `accepted`, its status is not done, and the base HEAD is unchanged. After the file is restored, the same accept succeeds.

acceptance.run: pnpm build && pnpm exec vitest run --project integration test/integration/review.test.ts
acceptance.proves: A real conflicting merge, or an accept into a dirty checkout, leaves no acceptance record and no half-merged checkout; successful and retry paths still work.
The revised local accept and merge error paths compile against core's public types.
The change passes biome, so CI's lint job stays green.
